facts.business: Solarium Green Energy Limited is an integrated solar solutions provider engaged in engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) of solar projects and solar module manufacturing.

capacity_or_capex.item: Fully automated solar module manufacturing line in Ahmedabad

guidance_or_targets.statement: Working capital levels elevated at year end owing to delay in commissioning of module manufacturing facility, expected to normalise as facility reaches full operation

key_risks: Gross margin moderation due to shift towards large scale projects with lower unit margins
Elevated working capital and finance costs due to delay in commissioning of module manufacturing facility
Dependence on external procurement prior to manufacturing facility full operation
